about: Every within-chapter cue seam of the projected inspection script (01-12), classified from the construct sources for coherent-unit planning. Source reading and arithmetic only: no Cargo, synthesis or measurement.

method.boundary: A think, an authored window (kit.music_breath), kit.hold/stand or wait_until/pause between two says makes the seam a unit boundary (events give file lines). Chapter ends are always boundaries.
method.animation_only: Otherwise tail_s is the hand-read total run time of the animations after the line's last wait_for anchor (derivation per seam); speech_after_anchor_s apportions the line's words at 2.68 words/s by characters from the anchor (the kit's timed_sentences rule); slack_s = speech - tail, slack_fast_s the same at 3.0 words/s. slack_s < 0.5 is a boundary (overrun if negative, tight otherwise); deliberate marks picture time designed to run past the line. Estimates, not measurements.
method.why: narration.rs say() requires zero inserted samples between contiguous cues of one coherent take (sounding edges), so a seam inside a unit must not wait on the picture.
method.preview: gap_s is the observed next-start minus end in root's native --scratch-voice render (2.6 words/s + 0.4 s a line); over 1.05 s means a hold or overrun. bound = rendered from today's chapter and script bytes; source-bound = chapter bytes equal, script changed since; unbound = input hashes not recorded. Corroboration only.
